purpose: Dependency boundary contract for SDK, CLI, and MCP packages. Keeps runtime dependencies intentional and prevents generated SDK internals from leaking into sibling packages.
toolchainCompilerSplit: SEC-5 (2026-08-09): the root lockfile hoists node_modules/typescript@5.9.3 while all three workspaces declare and resolve typescript@^7.0.2 in their own node_modules. The 5.9.3 copy satisfies typescript-eslint's peer range (>=4.8.4 <6.1.0), which does not admit TS 7 — so LINT parses the code under compiler major 5 while type-check/build/tests run under major 7. This is a known, deliberate split until typescript-eslint supports TS 7; if lint and tsc ever disagree about a construct, trust tsc and check this note before chasing the discrepancy.

rootDevDependencyIntent.esbuild: SEC-6 (2026-08-09): the root devDependency esbuild@0.28.1 is imported by nothing in this repo. It exists to pin the exact esbuild that npm hoists for tsx (tsx depends on esbuild ~0.28.0 and dedupes onto the root copy — package-lock resolves exactly one node_modules/esbuild at 0.28.1). Removing it would let tsx float its own esbuild patch level. If tsx is ever removed, remove this pin with it.
